title: SelCal M6-P1 artifact contract v8 proposal
description: PROPOSAL / NOT APPROVED / NOT FROZEN / NOT IMPLEMENTED / M6 NOT EXECUTED. This schema closes local shapes, discriminated unions, and hard bounds only. Dynamic arithmetic, cross-artifact identity, exhaustive comparison reconstruction, failure-automaton arithmetic, and lifecycle authority belong exclusively to selcal.m6-p1.semantic-validator.v8, which does not yet exist.

ImplementationSourceSets.x-semanticInvariant: roles are respectively REFERENCE_SOURCE, PRODUCTION_SOURCE, COMPARISON_DRIVER; embedded source sets have no lifecycle field and inherit the terminal root lifecycle

ComparisonRecord.x-semanticInvariant: validator reconstructs the exact ordered projection from both source artifacts; rejects empty, removed, duplicated-path, reordered, extra, or rule-substituted fields; DISAGREEMENT has exactly one diagnostic index and all other statuses have zero

CandidateCardinalityOperands.x-semanticInvariant: candidateVectorLength=C; persisted comparison counts equal Q*C, never 2*Q*C; simultaneousCandidateRecordsUpper=2*C<=5000

TerminalSummary.x-semanticInvariant: disagreementCount=diagnosticGroupCount; each disagreeing comparison index maps bijectively to exactly one completed diagnostic group

ExternalApprovalContract.x-semanticInvariant: this is the sole authority object; every approved terminal and budget profile carries exactly its externalBindingId and all five identities must match exact current bytes
